title: Barrel shifter
summary: A barrel shifter shifts/rotates an n-bit value by any amount in a single cycle. It uses log2(n) stages of 2:1 multiplexers. Stage i shifts by 2^i if the corresponding bit of the shift amount is 1. Supports: SHL (shift left logical), SHR (shift right logical), SAR (shift right arithmetic), ROL (rotate left), ROR (rotate right).

structure.meaning: Shift by 0 or 1 bit (controlled by shift_amount[0]).
Shift by 0 or 2 bits (controlled by shift_amount[1]).
Shift by 0 or 2^i bits (controlled by shift_amount[i]).

notes: Barrel shifter operates in a single cycle (combinational).
Used in ALU for shift/rotate instructions.
Arithmetic shift right (SAR) sign-extends (fills with sign bit).
